caption:
Canada’s only FREE accredited Zoo 🇨🇦🐊

There’s so much for kids and families to enjoy that we ended up spending half the day here! From crocodiles, turtles, monkeys, snakes, camels, llamas, and sheep to many other fascinating animals, there was something exciting around every corner.🦙🐒

Bonus: There’s also a splash pad to cool off on those hot summer days!☀️

💁🏻‍♀️Tips from our experience:
✔️Arrive early — it gets busy, especially since admission is free.
✔️Pack a change of clothes if the kids want to enjoy the splash pad.
✔️Bring water bottles and snacks to stay energized.
✔️Take advantage of the shaded picnic tables for breaks and lunch.
✔️Don’t forget sunscreen, hats, and sunglasses.
✔️Wear comfortable walking shoes — there’s plenty to explore.
✔️Bring a stroller or wagon (or baby carrier) for younger kids if you’re planning to stay for several hours.
✔️Plan to stay the night if you plan to explore more attractions nearby and have a relaxing trip.

There is also live music at the zoo and the train ride is currently closed but is expected to open in June.

📍Riverview Park and Zoo, Peterborough 
⏰Open from May 16th - Sept 7th

caption:
11 years later, and I still choose you. Every single time.❤️

We’ve been married for 11 years, but this feels like our first anniversary as a complete family…more love, more tiny hands to hold, more little moments to celebrate and living the life we once only dreamed about.🙏

We may not get the fancy date nights in this season of life, but honestly, what we have is so much more meaningful. We have a home full of memories being made in real time. We’ve become a team filling in for each other when one is tired, understanding each other without needing words, and loving each other deeper than ever before.😍

And this year feels even more special because it’s also my first Mother’s Day as a mom of two little boys.💙💙

Motherhood is exhausting, emotional, overwhelming, beautiful, and life-changing all at once. It teaches you strength you never knew you had and gives your heart a kind of love you can never put into words.👩🏻‍🍼

Here’s to growing old together, raising our kids together, and continuing to build this beautiful life we dreamed of.❤️

And a special thank you to our amazing photographer @rosejphotos for capturing these beautiful, raw moments of our family in the comfort of our home.

caption:
Hi, I am Tish- a mom of two boys, 8 months postpartum trying to survive motherhood without a village.🧑‍🧒‍🧒

I love being a mom but lets be honest, postpartum can be very challenging with no support. During the initial days I was lost and wished someone called and checked in on me, asked ‘how are you really doing?’, or asked me for a quick coffee break, walk or a drive.

I want to be that person for someone who needs to hear that you’re not alone. Because you can’t pour from an empty cup. 

That’s why I created @momsrecesstime- a space where moms can connect, share real-life experiences, support each another, and build meaningful connections.

💁🏻‍♀️I’m building the community I wish I had when I became a mom.

If you’re a new mom, a toddler mom or just a mom looking for genuine connections, Follow @momsrecesstime and comment ‘MOM’ to join our first meetup.

caption:
New Indian Vegetarian Restaurant in Brampton!🇨🇦

If you’re looking for authentic Indian flavors, this new takeout spot needs to be on your list!🤌

We tried the Delhi-style Chole Bhature, and it’s an absolute must-order! The buttery Pav Bhaji was packed with flavor, and the creamy Malai Paneer Tikka, fresh out of the tandoor, was perfectly smoky and delicious.🔥

Their sweets are made fresh from scratch every single day, and the Biscoff Kalakand literally melted in our mouths.😍

We also had the Biscoff Milkshake and Mango Mastani—both incredibly refreshing and so satisfying.🍹

They have catering packages available for parties & events. 

If you’re in Brampton, make sure to check them out—you won’t be disappointed!
